question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumatkāśyapa concludes with the rules on enclosure characteristics?
premises: The text is identified as the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
The chapter concerns the rules for enclosure characteristics.
inference: This concludes the forty-second chapter on the rules for enclosure characteristics in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the forty-second chapter, on the rules for the characteristics of enclosures, in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
